nom: Beekman 1802 Milk Shake Hyaluronic Acid & Squalane Facial Toner Mist

avis.texte: i use this toner a lot in the winter because its more hydrating than a regular toner, but not as sticky as a milky toner. i love the glow it has on my skin

avis.titre: My new AM routine staple for glowy skin
avis.texte: I've been using this Milk Shake Toner Mist for 2 weeks and I'm obsessed. The texture is super milky but it sinks in instantly with zero sticky residue. My skin feels hydrated and calm right after spraying, especially on dry, sensitive days. Love that it has goat milk and hyaluronic acid + squalane - it preps my skin perfectly for serum and makeup. I keep this at my desk for a midday refresh. It gives that healthy, dewy look without looking greasy. Found mine at Ulta. Definitely repurchasing!

avis.titre: try it if you've never before !!
avis.texte: first time trying beekman 1802 and i could say i'd definitely try their products again. they are certified cruelty-free which is a big must have for me !! i got this toner in a mini size and was definitely intrigued by the packages from the to phases it seems to have a oil at the top and a different type of liquid at the bottom. this product has goatmilk in it but even so the smell isn't too strong but i still don't like the smell of goat milk but it really isnt that big of an issue. also doesn't make the skin feel sticky. it feels very nice on the skin. i use it day and night. i feel like my skin looks more healthy and hydrated !

I used this spray from a store tester while I was browsing, and I had to come back the next day because I enjoyed it so much. However, the nozzle on the spray splits into two streams. I thought it was just the tester and figured that maybe someone had broken it, but when I purchased the product, it did the exact same thing. I tried to switch the caps on it, but I can't find one that fits. I really enjoy the spray, though! It's very hydrating and makes your skin glow.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this again
avis.texte: Love this! I use this in the morning after I wash my face before applying my other products and makeup, then during the day as a pick me up and st night before going to bed. Love how it feels and definitely see a difference already in my skin.

This toner mist is a great one to add to your collection. It has a unique bi-phase formula that is hydrating and calming to the skin. The mister is super fine and luxurious. You can even spray it directly into your hands and then gently pat it onto your face.

I will continue to use this toner. I love the way that it feels on my skin - I just wish that it was even more hydrating. I have decided that I will be purchasing another toner on top of this one. I love that it didn't cause my skin to break out!

I was totally influenced by social media on this and I'm so glad I was! It's such a fine mist but it leaves your skin feeling completely refreshed and the glow is amazing! I am in love and will absolutely recommend and repurchase this.

As a busy mom I don't have ALOT of time for myself but I try to always have my skin care locked in . With this brand ( toner,serum & moisturizer) it gives my skin the GLOW I want and leaves me feeling so hydrated AND clean ingredients because WHY NOT ? I will buy this over and over again !

avis.titre: Big fan of this toner mist
avis.texte: I use this facial toner mist in my morning and evening routines, but also randomly during the day for a refresh. As a dry skin girl, this product helps bring hydration back to my skin. Plus it is really fun to shake and mix up before using.

I have no idea why this product has so many positive reviews. Its not very moisturizing and it's inconvenient to use because: 1) you have to shake the bottle with every squirt to ensure the oil is mixed thoroughly. 2) you can't directly spray it on your face because the oil will get in your eyes. Yes, you can close your eyes but oil on my eyelids eventually makes its way into my eyes 3) it cant be used if you're wearing makeup because you have to spray it in your hands and then apply to your face When I purchased this I was in a hurry because the store was closing and the Ulta employee, who was helping me, recommended it based on customer reviews. I'm certainly not blaming him because it does have great reviews. But I probably should have thought about it more. I use a lot of moisturizing sprays because I have dry skin and I like to use them to set my makeup. Believe me-there are better products, especially at this price.
I saw this girl on TikTok talking about this toner and thought I would give it a try. This toner has made my skin so soft and glowy!! I cannot recommend this enough!!
Love this mist! My skin is loving it and it is so hydrating & refreshing!
Im beyond obsessed witg the milkshake facial spray. I have sensitive skin and it just calms it down immediately!

I'm genuinely obsessed with the Milk Shake Hyaluronic Acid & Squalane Facial Toner Mist. This is one of those products that actually does what it promises. It's made with hyaluronic acid, which helps pull moisture into the skin so it looks plump and hydrated, and squalane, which helps lock that moisture in while supporting your skin barrier without feeling heavy or greasy. The mist is super fine and refreshing, not harsh or dripping, and it instantly makes my skin feel soft, smooth, and revived. I've noticed my skin looks more glowy and feels less dry throughout the day. What I love most is how versatile it is. I use it anytime, anywhere, literally all day. It's perfect before makeup to prep and hydrate, and just as good after makeup to set everything and give a natural, dewy finish. It doesn't mess up my makeup at all, it just melts everything together beautifully. If you want something lightweight, hydrating, and easy to use throughout the day, this is definitely worth it. It's become a staple in my bag.

avis.titre: Yo tengo usando pir mas de 2 años este producto
avis.texte: Me encanta como me hidrata la piel,lo uso diario dia y noche y lo puedes usar con los productos que tu tienes.,pero mi piel le encanta
I have very dry skin and this mist was not as hydrating it left the skin feeling very oily and never absorbed. Would not purchase again but using it on the body not to waste it

avis.titre: Overall a good hydrating face mist
avis.texte: This is the first step in my routine for both mornings ans night skincate and also my first step to face prep for makeup. leaves my skin very hydrated with a healthy glow.

avis.titre: More of a serum than a toner & gets oil everywhere
avis.texte: I don't dislike this product, it's very moisturizing, but more of a serum than a toner. The spray will leave oil smears everywhere, clothing, surfaces, etc. Better to just spray into your hand. Product goes fast, and the plastic packaging is wasteful.

I use a chemical exfoliant at night, and you're meant to let a lot of them sit for a half hour before applying another layer. I like to use this to re-dampen my skin before applying moisturiser, and I'm pleasantly surprised by how much added moisturiser it adds. The mist is extremely fine, there's no discernible smell, and I feel like I look extra glowy afterwards. I still wouldn't ever be able to justify paying full price for this mist, but I will certainly enjoy using the rest of the bottle.

avis.titre: I love this product but the sprayer is always leaking
avis.texte: I absolutely love this spray!! im on my 3rd bottle and my only gripe is for some reason, the sprayer leaks! yoy have to shake the procuct to "activate" it and when you take the cap off, its product going to waste because its shaking out of the sprayer. please fix this
I absolutely love Beekman products. This milkshake toner is on my repeat buy list constantly. So good!

avis.texte: This toner mist far outshines the Bubble or Tower 28 toner mists. I have the mini size in my work bag, and it has genuinely helped the tone + texture of my face, as well as just being an amazing refresher throughout the workday. I 100% recommend.
Great product, makes my skin more hydrated than ever, its hard to find something that works on 40+ skin, this product works
I'm obsessed with this product. It's perfect for the nights I dermoplain my face!! It's so hydrating. It leaves my skin glowing and gorgeous.

I have insanely dry skin, like constantly flaking off and nothing seemed to help until i discovered this. it makes my face so soft and feels so moisturizing. def one of my top 2 cant live without products

I bought the travel size during the buy 1 get 1 free sale to try out. I liked it after first but after a few uses my eyes started getting irritated. I also noticed my skin was super oily then usual and doesnt really obsorb into the skin.

I rarely take the time to review things but just had to for this one unfortunately. I've tried to make it work, but every single time I use this spray it burns my eyes so badly! I have to wash it off my face after otherwise it doesn't go away. Beware if you have eye sensitivity.

Soaks into face nicely. It's not something I would use over makeup. My makeup is higher quality than his toner. Most of it is oil, you have to shake it up before every mist. Use it for my chest. Don't feel It's safe for my face.

originally had this in travel size in one of Beekman's mini kits. I loved it so much I bought full size. My skin is glowing, and the mist gives me a nice little boost during the day.

Not sure why they marker this it set make up. I use this in the morning and sometimes mid day as a light cleanser with a reusable cotton rouns. It does clean my face of light dirt. Leaves my skin feeling refreshed but still cleaned.

I almost never buy a product twice. I love thissss. I use it after cleansing or anytime my skin feels tight, extra dry, etc.

I have sensitive skin and this hasn't caused any unpleasant reactions.

avis.titre: Loved the Concept, but Sadly Irritated My Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product! I was initially drawn to it because of the clean, natural ingredients and the addition of probiotics, which seemed perfect for my sensitive skin. I'm almost done with my first bottle and had actually purchased a second one because I was so hopeful. However, I started noticing that whenever I spray it on my face, it leaves a burning sensation. I saw another review mentioning a possible allergy to blue thistle, which is in this formula, and now I'm wondering if that could be what's triggering the irritation for me. It's disappointing because I love everything else about this product — the concept, the ingredient list, and the way it feels initially. I just wish it worked better with my skin!

avis.titre: Perfect for a light toner or spray

Its a gentle spray toner, moisturizing. I bought the sampler kit for my Mom and sistera at Christmas brcause I loved it so much. ALL OF THEM LOVED THIS PRODUCT! They all have differnt akin types and concerns from dry,redmess, rosacea, to acne prone. I have normal skin with discoloration and skin texture. I'll do a quick spray all over. they are wonderful.

It is a wonderful product that hydrates the skin a lot and relaxes it.

avis.titre: I need my next bottle ASAP
avis.texte: This product is amazing! I grabbed this on a whim, mainly because of its clean and minimalist ingredients. I was looking for an all day hydrated look. This helps my skin look good even when it's the only product I'm applying to my skin that day, and after about 2 months of using this (it lasts awhile!) I notice my pores appear so much smaller, and nearly all of my dark spots from past acne have faded. The only thing that takes away from this product is how quickly it separates after giving it a good shake, though this is a natural process because of the oil and may not be preventable. It also has no scent, which may be preferable for those with more sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Moisture & Glow… In a spray bottle!

avis.titre: Mixed feelings about her but does work!!!

Save yourself the trouble and just get the full size.
Bought this before. It's moisturizing and leaves skin glowing.

I love this stuff! A tad bit expensive but so necessary for my skin. Leaves my skin hydrated and smooth.
I honestly love using mists because I feel like they're more hygienic and easier to use for people on the go, I also love how my skin feels with it on
This toner is amazing, winter and summer, know there I'm pregnant is everything I need and good moisturizer.

I purchased this toner because Ulta does not carry the glow recipe watermelon toner. For moisture there is no comparison. I do like the fact that it's a spray bottle, but I probably won't purchase again.

I also appreciate that the spray is actually a nice mister
My skin is definatley smoother and my pores are shrinking. My makeup looks flawless when i use this before application.
I purchased the mini Wicked edition of the spray. Its a great spray! Super hydrating and makes my skin feel soft.
